english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for yielding partway to someone’s demands or requests.
Use 讓步 when the compromise means giving up something or making a one-sided concession.

examples.english: This time we both need to make a concession before we can reach a deal.
examples.traditional: 今次我哋都要作出讓步，先至傾得成。
